notes.title: 《DreamControl Inc: Nightmare Cleane》Cinematics Fix Announcement
notes.content:
Update Time: March 3, 2025, 17:25 (UTC+8)


[h3]About This Game[/h3]

[list]
[*] Jointly developed by the first cohort of MZMCRAFT Associate Producers.
[*] Created within a tight 5-month development cycle - we appreciate your understanding regarding any remaining issues.
[/list]

[h3] Issue Fixes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Black Screen in Opening/Ending Cinematics:Install the official Microsoft HEVC Video Extension (v2.2.29.0) for Windows to enable HEVC video decoding.
[*] Download link: [url=https://pan.baidu.com/s/14t7xGDNzCBXBWTMV_TMBAg?pwd=96c2]Baidu Cloud[/url] (Extraction code: 96c2).
    Official Microsoft Store link: [url=https://www.microsoft.com/store/productId/9N4WGH0Z6VHQ]HEVC Video Extension[/url].
    Alternative installation: Search "HEVC Video Extension" in Microsoft Store and install directly.
[/list]
